title: NewSquare Capital LLC Lowers Stake in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

NewSquare Capital LLC trimmed its stake in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 17.3% during the third quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The firm owned 3,595 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 751 shares during the period. NewSquare Capital LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $554,000 as of its most recent SEC filing. 
Other large investors also recently made changes to their positions in the company. Blue Sky Asset Management LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the second quarter valued at $108,000. FNY Managed Accounts LLC grew its position in Apple by 852.4% in the second quarter. FNY Managed Accounts LLC now owns 800 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $115,000 after acquiring an additional 716 shares during the period. Private Vista LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the second quarter valued at $122,000. Armbruster Capital Management Inc. grew its position in Apple by 9.4% in the second quarter. Armbruster Capital Management Inc. now owns 911 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $131,000 after acquiring an additional 78 shares during the period. Finally, Crow Point Partners LLC grew its position in Apple by 100.0% in the third quarter. Crow Point Partners LLC now owns 1,000 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $153,000 after acquiring an additional 500 shares during the period. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 59.70% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts: 
Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) opened at $175.00 on Friday. The company has a current ratio of 1.24, a quick ratio of 1.20 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The stock has a market capitalization of $887,950.00, a PE ratio of 17.12, a P/E/G ratio of 1.34 and a beta of 1.33. Apple Inc. has a fifty-two week low of $137.05 and a fifty-two week high of $180.62. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The business had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period last year, the company earned $3.36 earnings per share. analysts anticipate that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 EPS for the current year. 
The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Investors of record on Monday, February 12th were issued a dividend of $0.63 per share. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.44%. Apple’s payout ratio is presently 24.66%. 
Several analysts have recently commented on the company. Vetr cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “hold” rating and set a $184.49 target price on the stock. in a report on Tuesday. BidaskClub upgraded Apple from a “sell” rating to a “hold” rating in a report on Saturday, February 17th. BMO Capital Markets cut Apple from an “outperform” rating to a “market perform” rating and increased their target price for the stock from $162.00 to $166.00 in a report on Wednesday, January 31st. Raymond James Financial restated a “market perform” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, February 16th. Finally, Sanford C. Bernstein set a $195.00 target price on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, January 30th. One investment analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and one has given a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $201.58. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of the stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the transaction, the insider now directly owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at $2,401,302.42. Apple Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
